title.en: Dao De Jing: The Book of the Way and Its Virtue

author.dates_zh: 传统上认为公元前 6 世纪

year_display.zh: 约成书于公元前 4–前 3 世纪

edition.en: Complete, 81 chapters. Received text in the Wang Bi line as given in Project Gutenberg eBook #24039; one misprint in chapter 30 (遠 for 還) is corrected against the Wang Bi text on Chinese Wikisource, two bracketed editorial insertions in chapter 29 are left out, and the brackets in chapter 23 are dropped.
edition.zh: 全本八十一章。据古腾堡计划电子书 #24039 所载通行本（王弼本系统）；第三十章一处误字（“远”当作“还”）据维基文库王弼本改正，第二十九章两处括注补文未收，第二十三章去掉括号。

basis.en: Classical Chinese text of the Warring States period; public domain everywhere.
basis.zh: 战国时期的古典文本，在全世界属于公有领域。

note.en: Eighty-one short chapters, the root text of Daoist thought and one of the most translated books in the world. It is shelved here complete, with a new English translation of every chapter that follows this edition’s readings. Notice how often it praises what is empty, low and soft: the hole at the hub of a wheel, the valley, water.
note.zh: 八十一章短文，道家思想的根本经典，也是世界上译本最多的书之一。这里全文上架，并附依此本文字逐章新译的英文。留意它多么常赞美空、低、柔：车毂中间的空处、山谷、水。

excerpt.orig: 上善若水。水善利萬物而不爭，處眾人之所惡，故幾於道。
excerpt.en: The highest good is like water. Water is good at helping the ten thousand things and does not compete with them. It settles in the places everyone else disdains, and so it comes close to the Way.
excerpt.zh: 上善若水。水善利万物而不争，处众人之所恶，故几于道。

gloss.en: 徼: an edge or boundary, the outer limit where a thing can be seen to end.
gloss.zh: 徼：边际、边界，指事物显现出来的界限。

gloss.en: 玄: dark, the deep colour of the far sky; here whatever is too deep to see into.
gloss.zh: 玄：黑中带赤的颜色，如远天之色，引申为幽深难测。

gloss.en: 惡 here is ugliness, the opposite of 美 beauty, not moral evil.
gloss.zh: 此处“恶”指丑，与“美”相对，不是道德上的恶。

gloss.en: 無為, not-doing: acting without forcing or self-assertion. It is the book’s central practice.
gloss.zh: 无为：不妄为、不强作，顺其自然而不刻意干预，是全书的核心主张。

gloss.en: To empty their hearts: to free them of scheming and craving, not of thought.
gloss.zh: 使其心虚静：去掉机心与贪欲，并非使人不思考。

gloss.en: 沖: empty, like a hollow vessel (read as 盅, a cup).
gloss.zh: 冲：通“盅”，器物中空的样子。

gloss.en: 帝 is the high god of early Chinese religion; the Way seems to come before even him.
gloss.zh: 帝：上古信仰中的天帝；意谓道似乎在天帝之前就已存在。

gloss.en: Straw dogs: figures plaited from grass for a sacrifice, honoured during the rite and thrown away after it.
gloss.zh: 用草扎成的狗，祭祀时用，祭后即弃；比喻任其自然，无所偏爱。

gloss.en: A bellows: 橐 is the leather bag, 籥 the pipe that carries the air.
gloss.zh: 风箱：橐是鼓风的皮囊，籥是送风的管子。

gloss.en: The spirit of the valley: the empty, inexhaustible power of the Way, pictured as a valley.
gloss.zh: 谷神：山谷般虚空而神妙的力量，比喻道。

gloss.en: 玄牝, the dark female: the mysterious mother from whom all things are born. 牝 is a female animal.
gloss.zh: 玄牝：玄妙的母性，比喻化生万物的根源；牝，雌性。

gloss.en: To hold oneself outside: to set one’s own interest aside.
gloss.zh: 把自身置之度外，不以私利为念。

gloss.en: 幾: near to, almost.
gloss.zh: 几：接近、差不多。

gloss.en: To hammer a blade and sharpen it; 梲 is read as 銳, sharp.
gloss.zh: 捶打使之尖锐；“棁”读作“锐”。

gloss.en: 營魄: the two souls, 營 the spirit (hun) and 魄 the body-soul (po); 載 is a particle opening the line.
gloss.zh: 营魄：即魂魄，营指魂，魄指依附形体的精气；载，句首语气词。

gloss.en: The gates of heaven: usually read as the senses, the openings through which one meets the world.
gloss.zh: 天门：多解为耳目口鼻等感官，人与外界交接的门户。

gloss.en: 轂: the hub of a wheel, where the spokes meet; its hollow centre takes the axle.
gloss.zh: 毂：车轮中心的圆木，周围插辐条，中间的空孔穿车轴。

gloss.en: To knead clay for pottery.
gloss.zh: 揉和黏土以制陶器。

gloss.en: The five colours (blue-green, red, yellow, white, black), like the five notes and five flavours, stand for the whole range of the senses’ pleasures.
gloss.zh: 五色指青、赤、黄、白、黑；与五音、五味一样，泛指一切感官享受。

gloss.en: 爽 here means to go wrong: the palate is spoiled.
gloss.zh: 爽：差失，指味觉败坏。

gloss.en: Favour is the lower thing: to be favoured is to stand beneath the one who grants it.
gloss.zh: 得宠本是卑下的事，因为受宠就要仰承施宠的人。

gloss.en: 夷 even, 希 faint, 微 minute: three names for what the senses cannot catch.
gloss.zh: 夷、希、微：无色、无声、无形，三者都是感官无法捕捉的。

gloss.en: 惚恍: elusive and evasive, something glimpsed and never fixed.
gloss.zh: 惚恍：若有若无、闪烁不定的样子。

gloss.en: 紀: the main cord of a net, by which the whole is held; the guiding thread.
gloss.zh: 纪：丝缕的头绪、网的总绳，引申为纲纪。

gloss.en: 豫 and 猶 (next clause) were said to be wary animals; together they make the word 猶豫, hesitation.
gloss.zh: 豫、犹（下句）相传都是多疑的野兽，合成“犹豫”一词。

gloss.en: 樸: uncarved wood, the raw block. It is the book’s image for the simple, unshaped nature.
gloss.zh: 朴：未经加工的原木，书中用来比喻质朴本真。

gloss.en: 芸芸: luxuriant, teeming, as plants grow.
gloss.zh: 芸芸：草木繁盛的样子，形容万物众多。

gloss.en: 復命: returning to one’s destiny, to what one was given to be.
gloss.zh: 复命：复归于本性、天命。

gloss.en: The highest: the best kind of ruler.
gloss.zh: 最上等的（统治者）。

gloss.en: The six relations: father and son, elder and younger brother, husband and wife.
gloss.zh: 六亲：父子、兄弟、夫妇。

gloss.en: 素 is undyed silk and 樸 uncarved wood: the plain material before any ornament.
gloss.zh: 素是未染色的生丝，朴是未雕琢的原木，都是未加文饰的本色。

gloss.en: 唯 is a respectful ‘yes’, 阿 a careless ‘ah’: the difference between courtesy and offhandedness.
gloss.zh: 唯是恭敬的应答，阿是怠慢的应答。

gloss.en: 太牢: the great sacrifice of ox, sheep and pig; here, a lavish feast.
gloss.zh: 太牢：牛、羊、猪三牲俱全的祭品，这里指丰盛的筵席。

gloss.en: 食母, the nourishing mother: the Way, which feeds all things.
gloss.zh: 食母：养育万物的母亲，比喻道。

gloss.en: 孔: great. 容: bearing, outward form.
gloss.zh: 孔：大。容：样态、动静。

gloss.en: 甫 is read as 始: the beginnings of all things. 閱: to look over, to see.
gloss.zh: 甫：通“父”，开始；众甫即万物的起始。阅：观察。

gloss.en: Holding to the One: keeping to the Way, undivided.
gloss.zh: 抱一：持守“一”，即持守道。

gloss.en: 伐: to boast of one’s merit.
gloss.zh: 伐：夸耀自己的功劳。

gloss.en: Sparing speech, above all sparing commands. 希 is the word chapter 14 uses for what cannot be heard.
gloss.zh: 希言：少说话，尤指少发号施令。“希”也见于第十四章，指听而不闻。

gloss.en: 飄風: a whirlwind, a sudden gale.
gloss.zh: 飘风：旋风、暴风。

gloss.en: 企: to stand on tiptoe.
gloss.zh: 企：踮起脚跟。

gloss.en: Leftover food and useless growths; 行 is read as 形, the body.
gloss.zh: 剩饭和赘瘤；“行”通“形”。

gloss.en: A person had a given name (名) and a courtesy name (字); the Way is given only a courtesy name, as if its true name were not known.
gloss.zh: 古人有名有字；这里只给它取个“字”叫道，表示不知其真名。

gloss.en: Some early editions read 人 (people) for 王 (the king) here.
gloss.zh: 一些版本此处作“人亦大”。

gloss.en: Baggage carts: the heavy covered wagons that carried supplies.
gloss.zh: 辎重：载运粮草衣物的车辆。

gloss.en: Lord of ten thousand chariots: the ruler of a great state, whose power was counted in war chariots.
gloss.zh: 拥有万辆兵车的国君，指大国之君。

gloss.en: 籌策: counting rods, the slips of bamboo used for reckoning.
gloss.zh: 筹策：古代计数用的竹签。

gloss.en: 關楗: the bar and bolt of a door.
gloss.zh: 关楗：门闩，关是横闩，楗是竖闩。

gloss.en: 襲明: following the light, a clarity kept within.
gloss.zh: 袭明：承袭、内藏的明智。

gloss.en: 谿: a ravine, the low channel where mountain water gathers.
gloss.zh: 溪：山间溪涧，汇聚流水的低处。

gloss.en: 制 is first the cutting of cloth to measure: the best shaping does not cut the whole apart.
gloss.zh: 制本义是裁剪：最好的裁制不割裂整体。

gloss.en: A sacred vessel: something that belongs to the spirits and cannot be handled at will.
gloss.zh: 神器：神圣之物，不可随意把弄。

gloss.en: 歔 is to breathe out gently, to warm with the breath; 吹 is to blow hard, to cool.
gloss.zh: 歔是缓缓呵气使暖，吹是急吹使凉。

gloss.en: Such things tend to come back: violence recoils on those who use it.
gloss.zh: 用兵之事容易得到报应。

gloss.en: 果: to achieve the aim, and then stop.
gloss.zh: 果：达到目的，适可而止。

gloss.en: In ritual the left was the side of honour in peace and good fortune, the right in war and mourning.
gloss.zh: 古礼以左为吉、右为凶：平时尚左，用兵与丧事尚右。

gloss.en: The lieutenant general, second in command.
gloss.zh: 偏将军：副将。

gloss.en: 自賓: to come as guests of one’s own accord, to submit willingly.
gloss.zh: 自宾：自动归服，如宾客来归。

gloss.en: Sweet dew: taken in ancient China as a sign of peace and good rule.
gloss.zh: 甘露：甜美的露水，古人视为太平的祥瑞。

gloss.en: Some read 亡 as 忘: to die and not be forgotten.
gloss.zh: “亡”或读作“忘”：身死而不被遗忘。

gloss.en: 氾: overflowing, spreading everywhere like a flood.
gloss.zh: 泛：广泛流溢的样子。

gloss.en: The great image: the Way itself, which has no shape (chapter 41).
gloss.zh: 大象：指无形的道（参见第四十一章“大象无形”）。

gloss.en: Peace, safety, ease; 太 is read as 泰.
gloss.zh: 安宁、平和、康泰；太通“泰”。

gloss.en: 歙: to draw in, to contract.
gloss.zh: 歙：收敛、合拢。

gloss.en: 微明: a subtle light, a small sign that shows what is coming.
gloss.zh: 微明：幽微的征兆中透出的明白道理。

gloss.en: The sharp tools of the state: its instruments of power, such as weapons and punishments.
gloss.zh: 利器：锐利的器具，指国家的权柄、兵刑。

gloss.en: The nameless uncarved wood: the Way before it is cut into names.
gloss.zh: 无名之朴：尚未被命名、分割的质朴，指道。

gloss.en: 攘臂: to bare the arm by pushing up the sleeve. 扔 here means to pull, not to throw.
gloss.zh: 攘臂：捋起袖子伸出胳膊。扔：牵引、强拉，不是“扔掉”。

gloss.en: 前識: foreknowledge, claiming to know before the event.
gloss.zh: 前识：先知先觉，预先的智识。

gloss.en: 貞: correct, the standard. Some texts read 正.
gloss.zh: 贞：正，指首领、准则；一本作“正”。

gloss.en: 不穀, ‘not good’: a humble title used by kings, like 孤 ‘orphan’ and 寡 ‘the lacking one’.
gloss.zh: 不穀：不善，王侯的谦称，与“孤”“寡”同类；穀，善。

gloss.en: Count up a carriage part by part and there is no carriage. Some read 輿 as 譽: seek too much praise and you have none.
gloss.zh: 一件件数车的部件，就没有车了。一说“舆”通“誉”：追求过多的荣誉，反而没有荣誉。

gloss.en: 琭琭: the gleam of polished jade. 珞珞: hard and rough, like stone.
gloss.zh: 琭琭：玉的光润貌。珞珞：石的坚硬粗糙貌。

gloss.en: 反 is both ‘opposite’ and ‘return’ (返).
gloss.zh: 反：既是相反，也是返回（通“返”）。

gloss.en: 建言: established sayings, an older store of maxims that Laozi quotes.
gloss.zh: 建言：古代立言者的格言，老子在此引用。

gloss.en: 纇: a knot in silk thread; rough, uneven.
gloss.zh: 纇：丝线上的疙瘩，引申为不平。

gloss.en: The great vessel is finished late. Some excavated manuscripts read 免成 or 曼成: the great vessel is never finished.
gloss.zh: 大器最后完成。一些出土简帛本作“免成”或“曼成”，意谓大器无所谓完成。

gloss.en: Yin is the shaded north side of a hill, yang the sunlit south: things have yin at their backs and face yang.
gloss.zh: 阴是山北背阳处，阳是山南向阳处；万物背阴而向阳。

gloss.en: 沖氣: the blending breath, in which yin and yang meet and mix.
gloss.zh: 冲气：阴阳二气相互激荡交融。

gloss.en: 強梁: the violent and overbearing (a 梁 is the strongest beam in a house).
gloss.zh: 强梁：强横凶暴的人。

gloss.en: 父 here is origin, root: the first principle of the teaching.
gloss.zh: 父：本、始；教父即施教的根本。

gloss.en: What has no substance enters where there is no gap.
gloss.zh: 无形之物，能进入没有缝隙的地方。

gloss.en: 亡: loss. 病: to do harm.
gloss.zh: 亡：失去。病：有害。

gloss.en: 訥: slow of speech, tongue-tied.
gloss.zh: 讷：说话迟钝。

gloss.en: Some editions read 躁勝寒，靜勝熱: movement overcomes cold, stillness overcomes heat.
gloss.zh: 一些版本作“躁胜寒，静胜热”。

gloss.en: The swift horses are sent back to manure and till the fields; 糞 is to fertilise.
gloss.zh: 把战马退回去耕田施肥；粪，施肥。

gloss.en: Even mares bear their foals on the battlefields at the borders.
gloss.zh: 战马在郊野的战场上产驹。

gloss.en: 牖: a window.
gloss.zh: 牖：窗户。

gloss.en: 損: to lessen, to let go of preconceptions and desires.
gloss.zh: 损：减少，指减去成见与欲望。

gloss.en: 德 is read as 得: and so goodness is gained. The same in 德信 below.
gloss.zh: 德通“得”：于是得到了善。下文“德信”同。

gloss.en: 歙歙: drawing in, restrained, holding oneself back.
gloss.zh: 歙歙：收敛、不张扬的样子。

gloss.en: 孩: to treat as small children.
gloss.zh: 孩：像对待孩子一样对待。

gloss.en: Coming forth into the world is life; going back into the earth is death.
gloss.zh: 出世为生，入地为死。

gloss.en: Three in ten; 有 is read as 又.
gloss.zh: 十分之三；有，通“又”。

gloss.en: 兕: a wild ox or rhinoceros-like beast.
gloss.zh: 兕：古代一种类似犀牛的野兽。

gloss.en: 亭 and 毒 are read as 成 and 熟: to shape them and ripen them.
gloss.zh: 亭、毒，即成、熟：使之成形、成熟。

gloss.en: 兌: an opening, one of the senses (or the mouth).
gloss.zh: 兑：孔窍，指耳目口鼻。

gloss.en: 習 is read as 襲: to follow the constant.
gloss.zh: 习：通“袭”，承袭常道。

gloss.en: 介然: in the slightest degree, a little.
gloss.zh: 介然：微小的样子。

gloss.en: The court is swept clean; 除 is to put in order.
gloss.zh: 朝廷宫殿十分整洁；除，修治。

gloss.en: 夸盜: boastful robbers. Han Feizi quotes the line as 盜竽, the leader of robbers.
gloss.zh: 夸盗：强盗头子；《韩非子·解老》引作“盗竽”。

gloss.en: 輟: to stop, to break off.
gloss.zh: 辍：停止、中断。

gloss.en: 赤子: a newborn child, named for its red skin.
gloss.zh: 赤子：初生的婴儿，因肤色红而得名。

gloss.en: Wasps, scorpions, vipers and snakes.
gloss.zh: 蜂、蝎、毒蛇之类的毒虫。

gloss.en: 全 is written 朘 in other texts: a baby boy’s penis. 作: stirs, rises.
gloss.zh: “全”在别本作“朘”，指男婴的生殖器；作，勃起。

gloss.en: 嗄: hoarse.
gloss.zh: 嗄：嗓音嘶哑。

gloss.en: 祥 here is an ill omen: to force life to increase invites harm.
gloss.zh: 祥：这里指妖祥、不祥；贪求增益生命反而招灾。

gloss.en: 玄同: the dark sameness, being at one with all things and set apart from none.
gloss.zh: 玄同：与万物玄妙地混同为一。

gloss.en: 奇: the unexpected, surprise, as against 正, the straight and regular.
gloss.zh: 奇：出其不意的奇谋，与“正”相对。

gloss.en: 忌諱: prohibitions and taboos.
gloss.zh: 忌讳：禁忌。

gloss.en: 悶悶: muddled and slow, a government that does not pry.
gloss.zh: 闷闷：宽厚而不精明苛察的样子。

gloss.en: 缺缺: sly and discontented.
gloss.zh: 缺缺：狡黠、不满的样子。

gloss.en: 廉: an edge, a corner. 劌: to cut, to wound.
gloss.zh: 廉：棱角。刿：割伤。

gloss.en: 嗇: restraint, thrift, first said of a farmer’s care in storing grain.
gloss.zh: 啬：爱惜、节俭，原指农夫收藏谷物。

gloss.en: 柢: the taproot.
gloss.zh: 柢：树木的主根。

gloss.en: 久視: to see for a long time, that is, to live long.
gloss.zh: 久视：长久地看，即长久存活。

gloss.en: Like cooking a small fish: turn it too often and it falls apart.
gloss.zh: 小鲜：小鱼。煎小鱼不可常常翻动，否则就碎了。

gloss.en: 蒞: to come to and oversee.
gloss.zh: 莅：临，治理。

gloss.en: 下流: the lower reaches of a river, where all waters gather.
gloss.zh: 下流：江河的下游，众水汇聚之处。

gloss.en: 奧: the inner southwest corner of a house, where the household gods were kept; a hidden shelter.
gloss.zh: 奥：室内西南角，古代祭神的深隐之处，引申为庇荫。

gloss.en: A jade disc so large it is held in both hands.
gloss.zh: 拱璧：需双手捧着的大璧。

gloss.en: 三公: the three highest ministers of state.
gloss.zh: 三公：辅佐天子的三位最高官员。

gloss.en: Repay resentment with virtue. In Analects 14.34 Confucius answers this saying: repay resentment with uprightness.
gloss.zh: 以德报怨。《论语·宪问》中孔子对此另有回答：“以直报怨，以德报德。”

gloss.en: 泮: to melt and break apart, as ice does.
gloss.zh: 泮：融解、分离，如冰消散。

gloss.en: 毫末: the tip of a fine hair, a tiny shoot.
gloss.zh: 毫末：毫毛的末梢，极言其细小。

gloss.en: 累土: a heap of earth, piled up little by little.
gloss.zh: 累土：一点点堆积起来的泥土。

gloss.en: 愚 here is plainness and simplicity, not stupidity.
gloss.zh: 愚：这里指淳朴质实，不是愚蠢。

gloss.en: 稽式: a pattern, a model to follow.
gloss.zh: 稽式：法则、法式。

gloss.en: King of the hundred valleys: the place to which all streams go.
gloss.zh: 百谷王：百川所归往的地方。

gloss.en: 肖: to resemble. Not resembling anything in particular.
gloss.zh: 肖：像。不肖，即不像任何具体的东西。

gloss.en: The three treasures: kindness, frugality, and not daring to be first.
gloss.zh: 三宝：慈、俭、不敢为天下先。

gloss.en: 器長: chief of all vessels, that is, leader of all things or of the officials.
gloss.zh: 器长：万物之长；器，指万物或百官。

gloss.en: 士 here is a commander or warrior.
gloss.zh: 士：这里指将帅、武士。

gloss.en: Matched with heaven: the highest standard since ancient times.
gloss.zh: 配天：与天道相合；古之极，自古以来的最高准则。

gloss.en: Host and guest: the side that attacks and the side that waits and answers.
gloss.zh: 主指主动进攻的一方，客指被动应战的一方。

gloss.en: To push up the sleeve with no arm to bare: readiness that never turns into a blow.
gloss.zh: 要捋袖奋臂，却像没有臂膀可举。

gloss.en: 則: to take as a model. 貴: rare and precious.
gloss.zh: 则：效法。贵：难得。

gloss.en: 褐: coarse woollen cloth, the clothing of the poor.
gloss.zh: 褐：粗毛布衣，贫者所穿。

gloss.en: 病病: to treat a fault as a fault.
gloss.zh: 病病：把毛病当作毛病。

gloss.en: 狎 is read as 狹: do not crowd or press them in their homes.
gloss.zh: 狎：通“狭”，逼迫、侵扰。

gloss.en: 繟然: unhurried, slack, at ease.
gloss.zh: 繟然：宽缓从容的样子。

gloss.en: The net of heaven; 恢恢 is vast and wide.
gloss.zh: 天网：天道如网；恢恢，宽广。

gloss.en: The appointed executioner: usually read as heaven, the natural order itself.
gloss.zh: 司杀者：专管杀人的，多解为天道。

gloss.en: 斲: to hew wood with an axe. 大匠: the master carpenter.
gloss.zh: 斲：用斧砍削。大匠：技艺高超的木匠。

gloss.en: 食稅: to eat up taxes, to live on what is levied.
gloss.zh: 食税：吞食赋税。

gloss.en: Wang Bi reads this too of those above: they seek too rich a life for themselves.
gloss.zh: 王弼解为在上者奉养自己太过丰厚；也可解为百姓求生心切。

gloss.en: 兵 here is to be cut down, as by weapons; some texts read 折, to break.
gloss.zh: 兵：被砍伐；一本作“折”。

gloss.en: 張弓: drawing (or stringing) a bow, adjusting the string high and low.
gloss.zh: 张弓：拉弓或上弦，弦高则压、弦低则抬。

gloss.en: 社 is the god of the soil and 稷 the god of grain; the lord of their altars is the ruler of the state.
gloss.zh: 社是土神，稷是谷神；社稷主即一国之君。

gloss.en: A contract was cut on wood or bamboo and split in two; the creditor kept the left half and could claim payment with it.
gloss.zh: 古代契约刻于竹木，剖为左右两半，债权人持左契，可凭以索债。

gloss.en: 徹: the Zhou dynasty tax on fields.
gloss.zh: 彻：周代的田税。

gloss.en: Tools that do the work of ten or a hundred people; some read it as the gear of squads of ten and a hundred, that is, weapons.
gloss.zh: 什伯之器：十倍百倍于人力的器械；一说指军中什伍所用的兵器。

gloss.en: Knotted cords were used for keeping records before writing.
gloss.zh: 结绳：文字出现以前，用绳子打结来记事。

gloss.en: 博: broadly learned, knowing a little of everything.
gloss.zh: 博：广博，什么都知道一点。

gloss.en: 積: to hoard, to store up for oneself.
gloss.zh: 积：积藏，为自己储存。

note.en: Some five thousand characters that founded a tradition and still reward every rereading; few books anywhere say so much about power, softness and restraint in so little space.
note.zh: 五千言开创了一个传统，至今每读每新；谈权力、柔弱与节制，很少有书能以如此短的篇幅说得这样深。
